results.title: Google Earth Engine | Google for Developers
results.description: Connect to the Earth Engine service through one of the APIs. Client libraries for JavaScript and Python translate complex geospatial analyses to Earth Engine requests. Or connect directly to Earth Engine servers using the REST API.

results.title: Earth Engine server release notes | Google Earth Engine | Google for Developers
results.description: Changed server behavior for dealing with dots (.) in workload tags. Before, tags containing dots were removed from the request, now an error will be thrown. Changed the default BIGTIFF parameter in the GeoTIFF image export options from IF_SAFER to YES, which always generates a BigTiff unless the BIGTIFF parameter is overridden in the formatOptions dictionary parameter. Upgraded GDAL to ab9e803 and libgeotiff to a6fb3d3. Earth Engine uses GDAL to ingest assets and to export Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) files.
